title: Restricted Mode: DataPass reads but runs nothing
as: A person opening a project folder they do not trust yet
goal: Open a fresh copy of the doc-pipeline example without trusting it, check that DataPass shows the project but runs neither Git nor tests, then trust it.
hints: VS Code asks whether you trust the authors: choose "No, I don't trust the authors".
Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P) → DataPass: Run Component Test… and pick PDF processing.
To trust: click "Restricted Mode" in the status bar, then Trust.
expected: "Restricted Mode" shows at the left of the status bar.
The DataPass Architecture view still draws the diagram (PDF inbox, PDF processing, JSON results).
The DataPass Git view shows "Restricted Mode: DataPass does not run Git".
DataPass: Run Component Test… on PDF processing is refused with a message that starts with "Restricted Mode", and no terminal or task starts.
After trusting the folder, the Restricted Mode message is gone from the DataPass Git view.
outOfScope: Running the component's tests after trusting it

ui.run: DataPass Architecture: Focus on Architecture View

ui.expect: Restricted Mode: DataPass does not run Git

ui.expectAbsent: Restricted Mode: DataPass does not run Git
